name: NotebookLM
description: Enterprise notebook research and source-grounded summaries.
api_breadth: Notebook lifecycle and sharing; API preview scoped to licensed enterprise users.
blockers: Enterprise license, Cloud project setup and NotebookLM IAM role required

evidence.title: Create and manage notebooks API
evidence.excerpt: Notebook management uses authenticated licensed users and the discoveryengine notebook API; setup requires the NotebookLM user role.

notes: Assigned NotebookLM hint refers to the enterprise product. Do not imply that a free consumer NotebookLM account exposes this API. Official MCP support was not established in reviewed sources.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Otter AI
description: Meeting transcription and searchable meeting knowledge.
api_breadth: Meeting search and transcript retrieval through the vendor MCP; general public REST access not established.
blockers: Plan eligibility and custom API application access need confirmation

evidence.title: Otter MCP Server
evidence.excerpt: Official OAuth-authenticated MCP endpoint supports meeting search and transcripts; the FAQ says a public API key is not available and directs custom application questions to support.

notes: An existing MCP integration is feasible; creating an independent REST connector is a different access question. No assertion that MCP is free on every Otter plan.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Fathom
description: Meeting recording, transcription, summaries and follow-up automation.
api_breadth: Meetings, transcripts, summaries, action items and recording downloads; signed meeting-ready webhooks.
blockers: Per-user visibility; no organisation-wide API key

evidence.title: Fathom API
evidence.excerpt: Self-generated user API keys, OAuth apps, webhooks and SDKs are included on all plans including Free; the page distinguishes the vendor MCP from the API.

evidence.title: Fathom developer introduction
evidence.excerpt: Developer documentation covers quickstart, API endpoints, webhooks, SDKs and public OAuth apps.

notes: Buildable for the authorising user’s visible meetings; do not promise access to other users’ unshared recordings. Documentation evidence only, not a tested connection.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Consensus
description: Evidence-based scientific literature search for research workflows.
api_breadth: Scientific search and structured paper findings; plan-dependent monthly pools.
blockers: Owner plan limits and monthly API/MCP usage pool apply

evidence.title: Consensus MCP setup
evidence.excerpt: Official MCP supports OAuth or profile-created bearer keys. Free accounts can connect; keys inherit their owner’s plan limits and shared monthly API usage pool.

notes: OAuth was an assignment hint, not the only supported method. Public documentation now also explains API-key authentication. This research does not establish unlimited free searches.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Reducto
description: Document parsing, extraction, classification and editing for AI pipelines.
api_breadth: Parse, extract, split, classify, edit and upload documents; hosted and local agent interfaces.
blockers: Metered document-processing allowance; hosted MCP cannot read local files directly

evidence.title: Reducto API quickstart
evidence.excerpt: Quickstart offers free account creation and API-key setup for document parsing. Free registration does not establish unlimited processing.

evidence.title: Reducto MCP server
evidence.excerpt: Vendor hosts a bearer-key MCP and provides local tooling with browser device login. Hosted upload accepts public URLs; local-file access requires the local server.

notes: Separate credential self-service from processing cost. API and local-tool credential flows differ.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Devin
description: Autonomous software engineering sessions and repository knowledge.
api_breadth: Repository documentation plus sessions, playbooks, knowledge, schedules and integrations.
blockers: Appropriate Devin account entitlement and organisation-scoped credentials required

evidence.title: Devin MCP
evidence.excerpt: Official MCP requires Devin credentials. Current service-user and personal tokens support organisation tools; legacy keys only support repository-documentation tools. Enterprise tokens require an organisation header.

notes: Devin MCP is authenticated; free public DeepWiki MCP is a separate service, not proof of free Devin platform access. Exact account plan eligibility should be checked before implementation.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: higgsfield
description: AI image and video generation through account tools and a separate developer API.
api_breadth: Media generation, status polling, cancellation, uploads and agent tooling.
blockers: CLI/MCP plan credits differ from a separately funded API balance

evidence.title: Higgsfield CLI integration routes
evidence.excerpt: CLI and MCP use browser sign-in and plan credits; the developer REST API uses an API key and a separate prepaid balance.

evidence.title: Higgsfield API quickstart
evidence.excerpt: REST generation uses the full copied API key, returns asynchronous request identifiers, and exposes polling, cancellation and uploads.

notes: Do not reuse the user’s unrelated Aerolink allowance for media generation or assume free UI generations apply to API/CLI calls.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Mermaid CLI
description: Local rendering of Mermaid definitions into diagrams.
api_breadth: Diagram rendering to SVG, PNG and PDF from local source.
capabilities: Use a local JavaScript rendering interface
blockers: Install the supported Node/browser runtime; isolate untrusted diagram execution

evidence.title: Mermaid CLI repository
evidence.excerpt: Maintainer repository documents local CLI rendering and programmatic use. It is open-source local software rather than an authenticated hosted REST service.

evidence.title: Mermaid CLI license
evidence.excerpt: The official repository publishes an MIT license.

notes: A local agent tool can wrap the CLI. No official MCP was established in this review; absence of a REST API is not a blocker for local agent-callable skills.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: YouTube Transcript
description: TranscriptAPI retrieval of YouTube transcripts, search and channel metadata.
api_breadth: Transcripts, language metadata, video search, channel feeds and playlist videos.
blockers: Starter credits are finite; ongoing usage is metered

evidence.title: TranscriptAPI API and MCP documentation
evidence.excerpt: Vendor documents bearer-key REST calls, its own MCP endpoint, supported YouTube data tools and 100 initial credits without a card.

notes: Assigned hint is transcriptapi.com, a third-party provider. Its official MCP is official to TranscriptAPI, not an official Google/YouTube MCP or unrestricted access to every video.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution

name: Grain
description: Meeting recordings, transcripts, notes and workspace insights.
api_breadth: Personal/workspace meeting data and OAuth integrations; MCP uses personal scope.
blockers: Workspace tokens require admin authority and plan entitlement; MCP does not accept workspace-scope tokens

evidence.title: Grain authentication
evidence.excerpt: Personal and workspace tokens plus OAuth are documented. Workspace scope is plan-restricted and admin-only; personal tokens also authenticate the MCP server.

evidence.title: Official Grain MCP
evidence.excerpt: Grain publishes a first-party MCP quickstart for meeting context and analytics.

notes: This is grain.com meeting software, not the unrelated rungrain.com developer workspace. Personal-scope and organisation-wide connector readiness are different.
research_method: Codex agent web search and first-party document opens; no vendor-account/API execution
